Senses.Explanation: An ancient buddha is a buddha placed in an earlier age, or a person addressed by that honorific comparison. Chan records invoke ancient buddhas as case figures, towers, precedents, and a measure applied to present speech; the title remains a person-category rather than a free conceptual abstraction.
